text: Welcome, fellow adventurers, to the very beginning of a saga unlike any other! Before the first shadow falls, before the first gasp of breath, before the world itself takes form, there is only... red. A crimson canvas, stark and absolute, heralds the dawn of "Test Manga" Chapter 1. This isn't just a color; it's a primal scream, a silent warning, an electrifying prelude to the untold dramas about to unfold. The stage is set, the very air hums with unseen energy, and the thrilling narrative is poised to burst forth from this mesmerizing void. Prepare yourselves, for the journey starts now!
